end.summary: Harsh practised reading and plotting ordered pairs (x, y) using left-right and up-down movement.
end.parentNote: Harsh practised locating points by moving horizontally first and vertically second, and connected the idea to directions on a cricket field. They correctly described left as negative and used movement steps, but continued to treat (3, 2) and (2, 3) as the same point; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. They also placed points on the axes in a quadrant, including the origin. At home, use a small grid to plot both pairs separately and mark the x-axis, y-axis, and origin.
